components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single high-confidence action used to plan or save a workout.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; height:2.75rem; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:.5rem; padding:0 .875rem; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:calc(var(--radius) * .8); background:var(--primary); color:var(--primary-foreground); font:600 .875rem/1 var(--font-sans),Arial,sans-serif; transition:background-color 150ms,box-shadow 150ms,border-color 150ms,transform 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:color-mix(in oklch,var(--primary) 80%,transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:none; border-color:var(--ring); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch,var(--ring) 50%,transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A quiet surface action for adding, reviewing, or repeating work.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display:inline-flex; height:2.75rem; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:.5rem; padding:0 .875rem; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:calc(var(--radius) * .8); background:var(--background); color:var(--foreground); font:600 .875rem/1 var(--font-sans),Arial,sans-serif; transition:background-color 150ms,box-shadow 150ms,border-color 150ms,transform 150ms; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background:var(--muted); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline:none; border-color:var(--ring); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch,var(--ring) 50%,transparent); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Workout Field
components.description: A labeled, high-target field for exercise names, dates, and actual values.
components.css: .ds-field { display:flex; min-width:0; flex-direction:column; gap:.375rem; color:var(--muted-foreground); font:600 .75rem/1.25 var(--font-sans),Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-field-input { box-sizing:border-box; width:100%; height:2.75rem; padding:.5rem .75rem; border:1px solid var(--input); border-radius:calc(var(--radius) * .8); background:var(--background); color:var(--foreground); font:400 1rem/1.5 var(--font-sans),Arial,sans-serif; transition:border-color 150ms,box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline:none; border-color:var(--ring); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch,var(--ring) 50%,transparent); } .ds-field-input:invalid { border-color:var(--destructive); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch,var(--destructive) 20%,transparent); }

components.name: Anatomy Zone
components.description: The clipped, high-contrast muscle-zone control that registers directly into the plan.
components.css: .ds-atlas-zone { display:flex; min-height:3rem; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:.5rem; padding:0 .75rem; border:1px solid #67879a; background:#18344a; color:#f4f3ec; clip-path:polygon(4% 0,96% 0,100% 50%,96% 100%,4% 100%,0 50%); font:600 .75rem/1.25 var(--font-sans),Arial,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; transition:background-color 150ms,border-color 150ms,color 150ms; } .ds-atlas-zone[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color:#7ce2d5; background:#7ce2d5; color:#10283b; } .ds-atlas-zone:hover { border-color:#7ce2d5; } .ds-atlas-zone:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgb(124 226 213 / .6); } .ds-atlas-zone svg { width:1rem; height:1rem; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:2; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; }

components.name: Surface Card
components.description: The reusable paper surface for supporting forms and measurement content.
components.html:
Today’s movement

Record the work around your training.
components.css: .ds-card { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:.5rem; padding:1rem; border-radius:calc(var(--radius) * 1.4); background:var(--card); color:var(--card-foreground); box-shadow:0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch,var(--foreground) 10%,transparent); font-family:var(--font-sans),Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-card-label { margin:0; color:var(--muted-foreground); font-size:.875rem; } .ds-card strong { font-size:1rem; font-weight:500; } .ds-card:focus-within { box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch,var(--ring) 50%,transparent); }

components.name: Primary Navigation Item
components.description: The icon-label destination used in the desktop rail and mobile bottom bar.
components.html: Home
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display:flex; min-height:2.75rem; align-items:center; justify-content:flex-start; gap:.5rem; padding:0 .75rem; border-radius:calc(var(--radius) * .8); color:var(--muted-foreground); font:500 .875rem/1 var(--font-sans),Arial,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:background-color 150ms,color 150ms; } .ds-nav-item[aria-current="page"] { background:var(--sidebar-accent); color:var(--sidebar-accent-foreground); } .ds-nav-item:hover { color:var(--foreground); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch,var(--sidebar-ring) 50%,transparent); } .ds-nav-item svg { width:1rem; height:1rem; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:2; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; }

components.name: Training Log Session
components.description: One recorded workout session presented as a navy-headed history sheet.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-log-session { overflow:hidden; border:1px solid var(--border); background:var(--card); color:var(--card-foreground); font-family:var(--font-sans),Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-log-session header { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:.75rem; padding:1rem; background:#132a3e; color:#f4f3ec; } .ds-log-session time { font-size:1.125rem; font-weight:600; } .ds-log-session header span { color:#c6d6df; font-size:.75rem; font-weight:600; } .ds-log-session a { display:flex; min-height:5rem; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center; gap:.25rem; padding:.75rem 1rem; color:inherit; text-decoration:none; transition:background-color 150ms; } .ds-log-session a:hover { background:var(--muted); } .ds-log-session a:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch,var(--ring) 50%,transparent); } .ds-log-session small { color:var(--muted-foreground); font-size:.875rem; }

components.name: Sticky Save Dock
components.description: The thumb-reachable session boundary that pairs the date with the single save action.
components.css: .ds-save-dock { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(8rem,.72fr) minmax(0,1.28fr); align-items:end; gap:.75rem; padding:.75rem; border:1px solid var(--border); background:var(--card); box-shadow:0 -8px 24px -18px color-mix(in oklab,var(--foreground) 55%,transparent); font-family:var(--font-sans),Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-save-dock label { display:flex; min-width:0; flex-direction:column; gap:.375rem; color:var(--muted-foreground); font-size:.75rem; font-weight:600; } .ds-save-dock input,.ds-save-dock button { box-sizing:border-box; height:3rem; } .ds-save-dock input { min-width:0; padding:.5rem .75rem; border:1px solid var(--input); border-radius:calc(var(--radius) * .8); background:var(--background); color:var(--foreground); } .ds-save-dock button { padding:0 1rem; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:calc(var(--radius) * .8); background:var(--primary); color:var(--primary-foreground); font-weight:600; } .ds-save-dock input:focus-visible,.ds-save-dock button:focus-visible { outline:none; border-color:var(--ring); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch,var(--ring) 50%,transparent); }

narrative.overview:
Gym Track treats the body as the plan. Its visual world combines deep clinical ink, mineral-white working surfaces, precise anatomy-plate contours, and sparse dry-erase coaching marks. It is an operational training instrument rather than an interchangeable KPI-card dashboard: the interface helps a gym-goer select zones, recognize recent work, record actuals, and preserve one trustworthy session.

The system is dense where the user edits a workout and calm everywhere else. Large neutral fields keep attention on the current task; oxygen teal makes active and recovered states unmistakable; coral appears only when effort, error, or attention requires it. The finished surface sits over a registered history layer, so recent routines feel recalled rather than generated.
keyCharacteristics: Deep ink and navy establish a focused, clinical training field.
Mineral-white surfaces keep forms legible under gym-floor conditions.
Oxygen teal identifies selection, completion, recovery, and primary action.
Laminated plates, clipped zone contours, fine rules, and registration labels carry the atlas metaphor.
Mobile composition keeps selection compact, the plan immediate, and the save action thumb-reachable.

rules.name: The Oxygen and Effort Rule
rules.body: Use oxygen teal for active, recovered, complete, and primary states; reserve coral for errors, destructive actions, or genuine attention.

rules.name: The Mineral Field Rule
rules.body: Let mineral-white and navy fields dominate the screen. Accent color is a precise signal, never ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Instrument Label Rule
rules.body: Use compact uppercase tracking for registration and metadata, never for paragraphs, exercise names, or primary actions.

rules.name: The Laminated, Not Floating Rule
rules.body: Use borders and tonal layering first; apply a shadow only when a major plate or sticky action must separate from adjacent content.

dos: Do make the body-zone choice the entry point to workout planning.
Do use oxygen teal to connect selection, completion, focus, and the primary save action.
Do keep recent-history cues attached to exercises and sessions so recalled values remain recognizable.
Do preserve 44–48px controls, explicit labels, visible focus, linked errors, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep the mobile save action above the bottom navigation and within thumb reach.
Do use dry, precise rules, registration labels, and clipped contours to carry the atlas metaphor.
donts: Don't replace the workflow with an interchangeable dashboard of KPI cards.
Don't use coral as a general brand accent or decorative highlight.
Don't invent exercises, anatomy imagery, health outcomes, or performance claims.
Don't let shadows, gradients, or soft floating cards replace the laminated plate structure.
Don't separate checked exercises into unrelated saves; the visible unit is one trustworthy dated session.
Don't turn the compact instrument-label style into dense uppercase body copy.
